decisions.reason: The reference class electrometer sits at the core of the firm's decades of dosimetry and calibration expertise. It is featured as a flagship on the home page. The firm's in-house R&D and research cooperation let it interpret early market feedback and refine the product.

The oncology risk management software builds on the firm's QA software integration knowledge and its goal of combining machine and patient QA. Strong related knowledge and R&D capacity make it likely the firm can assimilate early results and develop the product further rather than drop it.
